name: Images of Powerlessness AP OLD

stealth.note: (expert) to realize the illusory images conceal a magical trap (noticing the images has a DC of 0)

description: Psychically-enhanced illusions flood the minds of creatures in the 95-foot-long, 15-foot-wide hallway (the white dotted box on the map) with visions of their failures yet to come.
disable: DC 32 Occultism (master) or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to weaken the images; three successes are required to disable the trap
reset: The trap resets immediately and can affect the same creature multiple times on the creature's turn.

generalAbilities.name: Flood of Despair
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature ends a move action within the trap's area

Effect The triggering creature takes (2d10+10) Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 32 Will Saving Throw save) as it considers its future failures. A creature that takes damage hears a soft whisper offering, "Let me take something from you and I can stop the pain." A creature who agrees loses access to a random class feat that isn't a prerequisite for another feat, and the creature doesn't take further damage from Flood of Despair. This effect lasts for 1 week and can be ended by effects that remove curses. The creature also immediately detects the secret door at the end of the hall, no matter how far away from the end of the hall they are.
